description:
tikajs-3b5g: a \pict group is an embedded document, named embedded-N and the extension of what its hex data is (a \jpegblip holding a PNG is embedded-0.png), and its name is written as a heading inside the paragraph. Apache Tika 4.2.0 (/rmeta/body) for the same bytes: the container's text is 'x embedded-0.png

 y

' and a second record embedded-0.png of type image/png. The 1x1 PNG is synthetic.
